auth.description: You can create an API key by navigating to **Setting -> Extensions -> API**.

addTagToUser.name: addTagToUser
addTagToUser.description: Adds a tag to a user.

subscriberId.description: Please refer [Manychat Guide](https://help.manychat.com/hc/en-us/articles/14959510331420-How-to-generate-a-token-for-the-Manychat-API-and-where-to-get-parameters#h_01JCR55RJ0B0PQW6HDW6RW0A42) to obtain user/contact ID.

auth.description: You can create an API key by navigating to **Setting -> Extensions -> API**.

aiMetadata.description: Assigns an existing tag to a Manychat subscriber, identified by subscriber ID and tag ID, then returns the updated subscriber info. Use to label or segment a known contact (e.g. mark them as a lead). Idempotent: re-adding the same tag leaves the subscriber in the same state.

createSubscriber.name: createSubscriber
createSubscriber.description: Creates a Unified or a Whatsapp subscriber.

phone.description: Fill in at least one field: phone or email or whatsapp phone.

whatsapp_phone.description: Fill in at least one field: phone or email or whatsapp phone.

email.description: Fill in at least one field: phone or email or whatsapp phone.

consent_phrase.description: The consent phrase provided by the subscriber.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Manychat subscriber from contact details such as name, email, phone, or WhatsApp phone. Use when onboarding a new contact into Manychat. At least one of phone, email, or WhatsApp phone must be provided. Not idempotent: each call creates another subscriber.

findUserByCustomField.name: findUserByCustomField
findUserByCustomField.description: Finds a user by custom field.

auth.description: You can create an API key by navigating to **Setting -> Extensions -> API**.

aiMetadata.description: Searches Manychat subscribers by a custom field (text or number type) matching a given value, returning whether any matched and the list of matches. Use to look up a subscriber by a stored attribute when you do not have their subscriber ID. Read-only and idempotent.

name.description: Provide user's full name to search.

aiMetadata.description: Searches Manychat subscribers by full name, returning whether any matched and the list of matches. Use to resolve a contact to their subscriber record when you only know their name. Read-only and idempotent.

removeTagFromUser.name: removeTagFromUser
removeTagFromUser.description: Remove a tag from a user.

subscriberId.description: Please refer [Manychat Guide](https://help.manychat.com/hc/en-us/articles/14959510331420-How-to-generate-a-token-for-the-Manychat-API-and-where-to-get-parameters#h_01JCR55RJ0B0PQW6HDW6RW0A42) to obtain user/contact ID.

auth.description: You can create an API key by navigating to **Setting -> Extensions -> API**.

aiMetadata.description: Removes a tag from a Manychat subscriber, identified by subscriber ID and tag ID, then returns the updated subscriber info. Use to unlabel or de-segment a known contact. Idempotent: removing a tag the subscriber no longer has leaves the same state.

sendContentToUser.name: sendContentToUser
sendContentToUser.description: Sends a content to a user.

subscriber_id.description: Please refer [Manychat Guide](https://help.manychat.com/hc/en-us/articles/14959510331420-How-to-generate-a-token-for-the-Manychat-API-and-where-to-get-parameters#h_01JCR55RJ0B0PQW6HDW6RW0A42) to obtain user/contact ID.

platform.description: The platform to send the content to.

content_type.description: The type of content to send.

text_content.description: The text content to send. Required when content type is Text.

media_url.description: URL of the media to send (image, video, audio, or file). Required for media content types.

message_tag.description: The tag to use for the message.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a message to a Manychat subscriber, identified by subscriber ID, where the content type selects the mode: a text message, or a media message (image, video, audio, or file) referenced by URL. Use to deliver an outbound message to a known contact, optionally targeting a specific platform and applying a message tag. Text content is required for text mode and a media URL for media modes. Not idempotent: each call sends another message.

setCustomField.name: setCustomField
setCustomField.description: Ass or Updates a custom field value for a user.

subscriber_id.description: Please refer [Manychat Guide](https://help.manychat.com/hc/en-us/articles/14959510331420-How-to-generate-a-token-for-the-Manychat-API-and-where-to-get-parameters#h_01JCR55RJ0B0PQW6HDW6RW0A42) to obtain user/contact ID.

auth.description: You can create an API key by navigating to **Setting -> Extensions -> API**.
You can create an API key by navigating to **Setting -> Extensions -> API**.

aiMetadata.description: Sets or updates a custom field value on a Manychat subscriber, identified by subscriber ID and the chosen custom field, then returns the updated subscriber info. Use to store or change a single attribute on a known contact; the input type adapts to the field (text, number, date, or boolean). Idempotent: setting the same value again yields the same state.
